timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: It's an identity for an application or service instead of a user. Your code gets its own Entra ID identity.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: What's the difference between system and user-assigned managed identities?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: System-assigned is tied to one resource — delete the resource, identity goes away. User-assigned is independent, reusable across resources.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: OIDC federation lets GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Kubernetes authenticate to Azure without storing any secrets.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: The external platform issues a signed token. Azure validates the token against a trust relationship. No secret needed.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Can I use Conditional Access on workload identities?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Yes! Entra Workload ID supports Conditional Access. Restrict which networks, apps, or conditions a workload can authenticate from.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Federated credentials require proper trust configuration. Misconfigure the issuer URL and authentication breaks silently.
